name: @nudgeai/sdk
description: On-device wake-word detection without the enterprise price tag. Supports Node.js, Bun, and the browser
author: Nudge

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/streaming.test.mjs test/signature.test.mjs test/audio.test.mjs test/integration.test.mjs test/model.test.mjs
scripts.test:bun: npm run build && bun test test/
scripts.format: prettier --write src test examples scripts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test examples scripts package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run format:check
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run test:bun && npm run audit:dependencies
